requirements.statement: Exception entry selects the documented exception mode and vector, saves the pre-exception CPSR into that mode's SPSR except on Reset, enters ARM state, disables IRQ, additionally disables FIQ for Reset/FIQ, and requests a pipeline flush. Reset LR and SPSR values remain explicitly UNPREDICTABLE.

Undefined and SWI save the next instruction address; Prefetch Abort saves faulting instruction plus 4; Data Abort saves faulting instruction plus 8; IRQ and FIQ save the next instruction address plus 4.
ARM9TDMI Rev 3 exception vectors use base 0x00000000 when HIVECS is low and 0xFFFF0000 when HIVECS is high.
ARM946E-S exception vectors use the base selected by CP15 Control bit 13; that bit is initialized from VINITHI during reset.

source_refs.locator: §2.3.5 Control Register bit 13; Appendix B VINITHI
